examples.explanation: 11000101 10000010 00000001: a two-byte symbol plus a one-byte symbol.
The third byte 00000100 does not start with 10, breaking the symbol.
11111111 has eight leading ones, which starts no valid symbol.

hints: Examine only the low 8 bits of each integer.
Count leading ones of a symbol start to learn how many trailing bytes to demand.
Each trailing byte must have the form 10xxxxxx; a lone 10xxxxxx or a 11111xxx start fails.
title: 469. UTF-8 Validation
